name: ProvenMetal
long_description:
ProvenMetal manufactures the fastest circuit boards in the United States.

Domestic circuit board manufacturing is slow and expensive, and while reshoring is happening, the supply chain isn't there yet.

We automate the bottlenecks - part procurement, DFM review, and assembly - delivering circuit boards in days instead of weeks.
one_liner: AI-native electronics manufacturing for the American industrial base

launches.title: ProvenMetal - Fast-turn, American made PCBs
launches.tagline: Ship hardware just as fast as software
launches.body:
We're Johnny and Will - founders of ProvenMetal (YC S26). We assemble the fastest circuit boards in the US, out of a garage in Dogpatch, San Francisco.

Send us your design files and get assembled boards back in days instead of weeks.

<https://youtu.be/TH0XImuvNbc>

**The Problem**

Hardware companies - start-ups and large manufacturers alike - need speed to survive, and right now they wait weeks for circuit boards.

That time is lost to quoting, design review, part procurement, and assembly - bottlenecks we're automating.

At the same time, the reshoring wave is driving demand to manufacture critical infrastructure - drones, robotics, defense, energy - domestically.

But the capacity to assemble boards domestically, quickly and at scale, isn't there. Decades of offshoring hollowed it out, and what's left is slow and expensive.

The supply chain needed to revitalise American electronics manufacturing hasn't been built yet. We're building it.

**What We Do**

We're removing the bottlenecks that stand in the way of fast domestic PCB manufacturing.

Send us your design files, get instant quoting and rapid design review.

We source every component, assemble in San Francisco, and X-ray every board - delivered in days instead of weeks.

**The Founders**

Will Carkner (CTO) - Electrical Engineer, previously shipped the PCB testing pipeline at Lumindt.

Johnny Doyle (CEO) - Mechanical and Manufacturing Engineer, previously built IoT building management systems.

**The Ask**

Intros to drone companies that need hardware fast.
